data.name: Dayaananda
data.long_meaning: Dayaananda is a Sanskrit name, derived from the words 'daya' (joy, happiness) and 'ananda' (bliss, joy). This name signifies a giver of joy, a benevolent soul. In Hindu mythology, there is a sage named Dayananda Saraswati, who is revered for his wisdom and compassion. He is the founder of the Arya Samaj movement, promoting the Vedic teachings and social reforms.
